suggested_change: Add to CLAUDE.md: (1) Score carry-forward rule: 'If no new contradictory evidence appears in the current call, maintain prior score and explicitly state this.' (2) Next steps must be concrete and contact-specific, never vague exploration. Format: '[contact name/TBD]: Ask on next call: [specific question with measurable outcome].' (3) Deal health assessment must cite only call evidence, never CRM metadata—ground all claims in transcript or customer statements.
